verdict.rationale: Amplitude's docs name funnel building as a core analytics capability ('Build funnels, segment users, answer why') and let users jump from a funnel to the exact session. That supports the core of the story, but the evidence is only tagline-level: multi-step configuration, per-step filters, breakdowns and drop-off reporting are implied rather than documented. missing for 10: explicit documentation of multi-step funnel configuration, step-level filters and property breakdowns, drop-off/conversion reporting detail, independent or hands-on corroboration of funnel analysis
